purpose: Radiate attribution back to model creators and research that made this possible
flywheel_cycle: use models → benchmark → publish open → they find us → radiate attribution → more visibility → more cloners → stronger membrane → better models → repeat

llama.creator: Meta AI
papers: Touvron et al. 'LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models' (2023)
Dubey et al. 'The Llama 3 Herd of Models' (2024)
llama.contribution: Meta released Llama under permissive licenses, enabling local inference on commodity hardware. TinyLlama (community-trained on Llama architecture) proved that even 1.1B params can score 86% on domain tasks with membrane context. Llama 3.2 3B is our top scorer at 94% chipMUNK.
llama.what_we_owe: The architecture that made local AI possible. Open weights. Open research.

gemma.creator: Google DeepMind
papers: Gemma Team. 'Gemma: Open Models Based on Gemini Research and Technology' (2024)
Gemma Team. 'Gemma 2: Improving Open Language Models at a Practical Size' (2024)
gemma.contribution: Gemma 2 2B proved that 2B parameters with good architecture matches 7B models. Identical functional DNA to Qwen 2.5 7B in our arena (distance = 0.0). 88% chipMUNK, 100% membrane. The smallest model to hit perfect membrane score.
gemma.what_we_owe: Proof that architecture > parameter count. Efficient small models.

mistral.creator: Mistral AI (Paris)
mistral.contribution: Mistral 7B (Sep 2023) was the first model to prove open-weight 7B could compete with closed models. 88% chipMUNK, 100% membrane. Apache 2.0 license. NeMo 12B (Jul 2024) with 128K context is the sweet spot for membrane-wrapped inference.
mistral.what_we_owe: European open AI. Apache 2.0 license. The 7B size class proof.

qwen.creator: Alibaba Cloud (Qwen Team)
qwen.contribution: Qwen 2.5 7B at 88% chipMUNK, 100% membrane. Fastest evolution: Qwen→Qwen1.5→Qwen2→Qwen2.5→Qwen3 in 18 months. Identical phenotype to Gemma 2 2B (distance=0.0) despite being 3.5x larger.

phi.creator: Microsoft Research
phi.contribution: Phi-3 (3.8B, MIT) at 85% chipMUNK, 100% membrane. Microsoft proved that textbook-quality training data matters more than scale. MIT license is the most permissive of all tested models.
phi.what_we_owe: Data quality > scale thesis. MIT license. Research openness.

cross_domain_attributions.paper: Tracing Model Evolution via Functional Representations
cross_domain_attributions.contribution: Defined LLM DNA as functional behavior vectors. Built phylogenetic trees of 305 LLMs.
cross_domain_attributions.how_we_used_it: Inspired our arena-taxonomy.py — chipMUNK 6-category scores AS functional DNA.

cross_domain_attributions.paper: LLMOrbit: A Circular Taxonomy of LLMs
cross_domain_attributions.contribution: Comprehensive circular taxonomy, 50+ models, 8 orbital dimensions.
cross_domain_attributions.how_we_used_it: Informed our Kingdom Silica phylum structure.

cross_domain_attributions.contribution: First interactive AlphaFold → sound. Hydrophobicity → pitch. Confidence → dynamics.
cross_domain_attributions.how_we_used_it: Our protein-sonify.py uses the same hydrophobicity→pitch mapping.

cross_domain_attributions.contribution: First systematic protein-to-MIDI converter. Server still running.
cross_domain_attributions.how_we_used_it: Proved the concept works. Our implementation is stdlib-only Python.

cross_domain_attributions.paper: Sonification of 3D Protein Structures Using Supervised ML
cross_domain_attributions.contribution: KNN + centre of mass → C-major pitches. B-factor → duration.
cross_domain_attributions.how_we_used_it: Our centre-of-mass velocity mapping follows their approach.

cross_domain_attributions.contribution: Sonified folding PROCESS, not just static structure.
cross_domain_attributions.how_we_used_it: Inspiration for future: sonify our chaos injection phase transitions.

cross_domain_attributions.paper: Private LLM Inference on Consumer Blackwell GPUs
cross_domain_attributions.contribution: Proved self-hosted inference is 40-200x cheaper than cloud APIs.
cross_domain_attributions.how_we_used_it: Validates our sovereign compute thesis on newer hardware.

cross_domain_attributions.contribution: Proved domain context closes the gap for small models.
